rows.notes: Company plan (board announcement 2024-11-19): 10 GWh storage cells + systems + shared-storage R&D base, CNY 5bn, two phases, phase 1 originally due Sept 2025 (S3, S3b). EIA for 'phase 1, 5 GWh/yr' was only accepted by the Guangde bureau on 2025-09-25 (S4), i.e. after the planned production date, and Great Power told investors on 2025-11-24 that the Guangde and Ulanqab projects were 暂未投产 (S5). No page found showing groundbreaking or construction progress (2025-26 searches in Chinese found none), and the 2025 annual report lists only Henan and Quzhou as new domestic capacity under construction (S2 quote is for Quzhou row). Status kept at announced (construction not confirmed), project_state active but likely stalled. Phase split: phase 1 5 GWh (S4) + phase 2 5 GWh implied by 10 GWh total (S3), phase 2 undated. ref_year 2024: fallback, searched (publication year of the source stating the full plan; no dated full-capacity target). v1 values removed because unconfirmed: start_year 2025, chemistry LFP, capacity_by_year. Guosheng Securities report 2026-04-14 (dfcfw H3_AP202604141821170638_1.pdf, chart 31) still lists this project as 10 GWh/yr, planned production 2025-09, i.e. not updated. [ESCALATE: 10 GWh row below 0.6; no later news found].

2025 annual report names Guangzhou as one of 9 stably operating production bases (S1) but gives no site capacity (company-wide only: '86.64 亿 Ah 年化' lithium-ion capacity, 126.46% utilisation, p.14 of the report; Ah not convertible to GWh by site). v1 nameplate 2 GWh (2023 investor summaries, consumer cells) could not be confirmed with an open page and is nulled; chemistry/format/end_market (consumer) also unconfirmed so nulled. Original Panyu base of a 2001-founded consumer/small-cell maker; kept as operational with null capacity.

Announcement 2024-07-21 (S6, S7b): 10 GWh/yr storage cells + system integration (fixed-asset CNY 1.8bn, construction planned Sept 2024, production planned Oct 2025) plus 1 GWh/yr semi-solid-state line (CNY 0.5bn, construction planned May 2025, production July 2026 - S7). Nameplate 11 = 10 + 1; ref_year 2026 = scheduled production start of the last line (no 达产 date published). Great Power told investors on 2025-11-24 that the Ulanqab project was 暂未投产 (S5). I found NO page confirming groundbreaking or construction progress, so v1's under_construction is not carried (status announced = no confirmed construction); v1's 'trial production Oct 2025' (caifuhao 2025-10-14) is contradicted by S5 and not used. Not mentioned among expansions under construction in the 2025 annual report. v1 chemistry 'mixed' and sodium-ion hint unconfirmed, nulled. Guosheng Securities 2026-04-14 (chart 31) still lists 10 GWh (planned 2025-10) and 1 GWh (planned 2026-07) from company announcements only. [ESCALATE: 11 GWh row below 0.6; status unresolved - need company investor-relations record or Inner Mongolia government page].

Zhumadian (Henan Penghui, Yicheng district) is listed among 9 stably operating bases in the 2025 annual report (S1) and 'domestic new capacity in Henan' is being built (S2, quote on Quzhou row). No open page states a GWh figure for the existing Zhumadian base: v1's 5 GWh came from an unverified brokerage summary and is nulled. Announced expansion in Yicheng (2026-02-12 announcement, CNY 1.2bn, one 587Ah line + one 120Ah line, no GWh stated - eastmoney 2026-02-16 https://finance.eastmoney.com/a/202602163651173633.html; Guosheng chart 31 also shows no GWh). The Zhengyang County project (13.5 GWh + 1.5-2 GWh phase 1) is a separate site in Zhumadian prefecture and is added as its own row to avoid mixing. v1 chemistry/format/end_market unconfirmed, nulled.

Kept as the single Liuzhou row; the duplicate row penghui-energy-penghui-liuzhou-base... is removed (duplicate_of this id). Groundbreaking 2022-01-10, northern ecological new area, 'overall planning capacity of 20GWh' (S15). Liuzhou is one of the 9 stably operating bases (S1); the 2025 annual report's construction-in-progress table still carries the 'Liuzhou smart energy storage and power battery manufacturing base' item at about 61.9% progress at end-2025, i.e. later phases are still under construction (table text garbled in the extract, not quotable). Phase detail (5.5 GWh online 2022, +5 GWh 2023 = 10.5 GWh; further 5 + 9.5 GWh planned per a Jan-2023 brokerage note) rests on bjx.com.cn 2023-05-31, which could not be fetched (WAF) - so installed_capacity left null rather than 10.5. ref_year 2022: fallback, searched (no dated full-capacity target on a fetched page; v1 said phase II production by end-March 2026 from ne21.com, page timed out). v1 chemistry LFP/prismatic/mixed, announced_year 2021 and start_year 2022 not confirmed from a fetched page, nulled. Qingdao Daily 2025-09-10 (S9, S9b, S9c): three phases, ~CNY 13bn, 'planning design capacity 36 GWh'; phase 1 cell plant built and in production, lines A/B/C all on, line A at >80% of design capacity, 314Ah line at full production by end-Aug 2025. Phase 1 = 12 GWh of 314Ah LFP cells (S10, SMM 2025-04-27: 'will produce 12GWh of 314Ah lithium iron phosphate (LFP) cells annually'). installed 12 basis: press/design capacity of phase 1 (not a company effective figure); line A 80%+ of design, so effective output is somewhat lower. Same site as the Great Power Liuzhou row: identical project name 'Penghui Energy Liuzhou Smart Energy Storage and Power Battery Manufacturing Base', Liuzhou northern ecological new area, 20 GWh plan (S15). Penghui Energy is the Chinese-language short name of Great Power (鹏辉能源, 300438).
